title: 사립학교보조와원조에관한건 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20080304:00004:part:1/1

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 4, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (24) Omitted.

(25) The Decree on Subsidies and Assistance for Private Schools is partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (1) and (2), the main clause and proviso of Article 4 (1), the part of Article 4 (2) other than its subparagraphs, the part of Article 5 (1) other than its subparagraphs, subparagraph 5 of that paragraph, and Article 5 (2), the term "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development" shall be replaced, respectively, with "Minister of Education, Science and Technology".

(26) through (63) Omitted.
